name: zawo
description: A private local SSH and terminal workspace
author: Zawo

scripts.package: npm run icon && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 && node scripts/sign-local.cjs
scripts.test:core: node --test test/store.test.cjs test/network-store.test.cjs test/local.test.cjs test/network.test.cjs test/local-browser.test.cjs test/workspace.test.cjs test/library.test.cjs test/keys.test.cjs test/files.test.cjs test/preferences.test.cjs test/reliability.test.cjs test/sftp-recovery.test.cjs test/backup.test.cjs test/migration.test.cjs test/autosave.test.cjs test/editor-drafts.test.cjs test/browser-policy.test.cjs test/terminal-web-links.test.cjs test/shortcuts.test.cjs test/browser-cli.test.cjs test/agent-integrations.test.cjs test/terminal-color-sync.test.cjs
scripts.package:release: npm run icon && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=dist/release && node scripts/sign-release.cjs
